intro.TrustedMarkup: Higher-order array helpers such as map, filter and fold, in Vyrn. Applies f to every element, collecting the results into a new array.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn map<T, U>(xs: Array<T>, f: fn(T) -> U) -> Array<U>

prose.TrustedMarkup: Applies f to every element, collecting the results into a new array.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn filter<T>(xs: Array<T>, pred: fn(T) -> Bool) -> Array<T>

prose.TrustedMarkup: Keeps only the elements for which pred returns true.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn fold<T, A>(xs: Array<T>, init: A, f: fn(A, T) -> A) -> A

prose.TrustedMarkup: Left fold: threads acc through f for every element, starting from init.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn any<T>(xs: Array<T>, pred: fn(T) -> Bool) -> Bool

prose.TrustedMarkup: Whether pred holds for at least one element.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn all<T>(xs: Array<T>, pred: fn(T) -> Bool) -> Bool

prose.TrustedMarkup: Whether pred holds for every element; true when empty.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn includes(xs: Array<String>, x: String) -> Bool

prose.TrustedMarkup: Whether xs contains the string x. The parameter is Array<String>, not generic, because a generic Array<T> parameter does not accept a fixed-size array literal.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn sortWith<T>(xs: Array<T>, cmp: fn(T, T) -> Int64) -> Array<T>

prose.TrustedMarkup: A stable sorted copy, ordered by a comparator: negative puts a before b, positive after, zero keeps arrival order. Insertion sort.

sig.TrustedMarkup: fn sortBy<T>(xs: Array<T>, key: fn(T) -> Int64) -> Array<T>

prose.TrustedMarkup: A stable sorted copy, ascending by an Int64 key. Insertion sort.
